name: Stack-TS-TW
title: Swipeable Card Stack
description: A small deck of square photo cards stacked with a slight fan. Drag the top card off to throw it to the back of the pile, or click it to shuffle it under while a spring settles the rest.
use: You want a tactile little gallery or testimonial deck a visitor can flip through by dragging the top card away.
avoid: It needs a sized square-ish container, and the drag or click has no keyboard equivalent.
a11y: Cards are plain divs with no keyboard focus or arrow-key support, and the spring swipe ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stack of square photos with rounded corners: the front card flat and full-size while the ones behind poke out at the top-right, each nudged a few degrees and slightly smaller. On a near-black stage a line of grey helper text sits below the pile.
behaves: Dragging the front card tilts it in 3D and, past a set distance, throws it to the back of the deck; a spring fans the remaining cards into place. Clicking also sends the card back, and an optional autoplay cycles them on a timer.
customise: You pass an array of cards (any nodes, usually images) plus sensitivity, autoplay timing, click-to-send-back, random rotation, spring stiffness and a mobile breakpoint. Card styling is your own.
weight: light: A handful of motion-driven cards that only animate when swiped or on the optional autoplay timer.
